info.title: Merran API
info.description: Everything the Merran app does, it does through this API: the same routes are open to scripts and to tools like Home Assistant. Tools use an API key: make one at `POST /api/auth/api-keys` while signed in, then send it as `Authorization: Bearer mrn_…`. Each route says whether a key can use it, and with which permission. Browsers sign in with `POST /api/auth/sign-in/username` and send the session cookie it sets.

server.description: The address you reach Merran at

tags.name: Sign-in
tags.description: Setting up the server, signing in and out, invite links and switching households. Signed-in requests carry the session cookie.

tags.name: API keys
tags.description: Keys for scripts and tools like Home Assistant. Each acts as its person in one household, with only the permissions it was given, and stops working if it expires, is revoked, or its person leaves the household.

tags.name: Households
tags.description: The household in use: its settings, its people and their roles, and invite links.

tags.name: Recipes
tags.description: The household's recipes, their tags and versions, and Recently deleted. Ingredients and steps are written as lines, as in the editor, and each ingredient line is read into its amount, unit, food and note.

tags.name: Settings
tags.description: Settings for the server (its admin only) and the household in use. A setting from an environment variable is locked, and a secret is never sent back: only whether it's set, and its last four characters.

tags.name: Server
tags.description: Whether the server is up and ready, and which of Merran's optional parts are on. No sign-in needed.

diets.description: Diet labels worked out from the ingredients, with the household's corrections.

photo.description: Where its photo is, in each size, or null. The links change with the photo, so they can be kept.

by.description: Who cooked it, if they're still here.

rating.description: 1 to 5 stars. They become the recipe's rating.

rating.description: From 1 to 5 stars, or null to clear it.

value.description: Its value, or null for a secret or a setting that isn't set.

lockedBy.description: The environment variable that sets it, which means it can't be changed here.

SettingChanges.description: New values by key. Null puts a setting back to its default, and deletes a secret.

get.description: Your keys in every household you're in, newest first. The keys themselves can't be shown again.

post.description: For the household in use. It acts as you there, with only the permissions given, and stops working if you leave. The key is shown only in this response. Making a key needs a sign-in: a key can't make another.

400.description: Signed out, and no account was sent.

429.description: Too many wrong codes. Try again in a few minutes.

get.description: Which of Merran's optional parts are on, what they make possible, and what the web app needs from them. Needs no sign-in: the web app reads it before anyone signs in.
Answers as long as the server is running. Needs no sign-in, and says nothing personal.

Pages without recipe data, and video links, can't be imported yet. With an API key, it needs the `recipes: write` permission.
